changelog: Affiliate transaction price list (#3843): `AffiliateProgramSettings.priceList` (free limit, base fee, per-transaction steps with sub-cent prices, VAT) priced by the pure `src/lib/affiliatePriceListRule.ts` — the month is summed exactly and rounded to the cent once; set on the settings page with a live example table (`PUT /api/admin/affiliate/settings/price-list`). Customers can be marked reverse charge (`AffiliateCustomer.reverseCharge`, `PATCH /api/admin/affiliate/customers/[id]`), and the price list says whether their list price still gets VAT. The price list travels in the settings export/import as its own `priceList` section, judged by its own parser and written through `savePriceList()`; a list never set is left out of the file.

en: Affiliate settings: a transaction price list with free limit, base fee, steps and VAT, with a live example of what a month costs. Customers can be marked as reverse charge. The price list is part of the settings export and import.
tr: Affiliate ayarları: ücretsiz sınır, temel ücret, kademeler ve KDV içeren işlem fiyat listesi; bir ayın ne tuttuğu canlı örnekle görünür. Müşteriler ters vergi olarak işaretlenebilir. Fiyat listesi ayarların dışa ve içe aktarımına dahil.
de: Affiliate-Einstellungen: eine Transaktions-Preisliste mit Freigrenze, Grundgebühr, Stufen und MwSt., mit Live-Beispiel, was ein Monat kostet. Kunden lassen sich als Reverse Charge markieren. Die Preisliste ist Teil von Export und Import der Einstellungen.
